subject: Capacity upgrade & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@acceleratorai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, procurement@acceleratorai.com
Cc: Tim Shaw <tim.shaw@ecoserve.io>
Date: Wed, 31 Jan 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity upgrade & procurement timeline

Hi Diego,

Quick note from my side — Accelerator is planning a Q2 capacity uplift for our inference tier (~2x peak tokens) and procurement wants to understand timeline and committed pricing for a dedicated uplift. We have an internal bakeoff in-flight where a competitor is offering a short trial and a 6–12 month term with an aggressive price per token.

Can Redwood provide:
- A short proof plan we can run this week (3–5 day bench)
- Committed uplift pricing for a 12-month reserved capacity (range + best-effort)
- Any commercial levers (credits, onboarding assistance) to reduce switching risk

Tim is copied — he’ll own procurement logistics. We’d like a one-pager and an executable benchmark script to run in our lab.

Thanks,
Elena
VP, Platform Engineering
Accelerator AI
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acceleratorai.com>
Cc: Tim Shaw <tim.shaw@ecoserve.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Feb 2028 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity upgrade & procurement timeline

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up. We can turn this around quickly. Proposed plan:

1) Bench: 3-day focused benchmark (we’ll provide a lightweight script + sample prompt sets)
2) Commercial: A 12-month reserved uplift quote with a short-term pilot discount and an onboarding credit to cover migration/ops testing.
3) Ops: Canary rollout guidance (traffic split, pre-warm) to minimize token spikes.

Marissa — can you draft a framing one-pager and a starter uplift quote? Karthik, can you review the bench steps and share the script we typically use for throughput/latency parity tests?

Elena — I’ve attached a quick market approach doc that shows how we typically structure uplift deals. If the bakeoff window is this week, we’ll prioritize the script and a 1-page offer. What days work for a short kickoff call?

[Attachment: Accelerator_MA_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 132KB)]

Best,
Diego
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acceleratorai.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Shaw <tim.shaw@ecoserve.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Feb 2028 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity upgrade & procurement timeline

Elena / Team —

Attached is a concise commercial note for a 12-month reserved uplift and the option for a phased ramp. Highlights:
- 2x uplift (reserved): baseline list price less 18% committed discount; additional 5% credit for first-month ops costs
- Pilot: 10% pilot discount for a 30-day litmus (non-refundable onboarding credit applies)
- SLA: 99.9% monthly availability on Dedicated tiers; escalation path included

We’ll need approximate peak tokens/day to firm the final quote. Diego — suggested call slots: Mon 2/6 09:00–11:00 PT or Tue 2/7 13:00–15:00 PT.

[Attachment: Accelerator_MA_plan_v1.pdf (commercial summary)]

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acceleratorai.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Feb 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity upgrade & procurement timeline

Elena —

Attaching a short benchmark script and runbook we use for parity tests. Key points:
- 3 workload profiles (latency-sensitive, throughput-burst, mixed)
- KV cache warmup recommended for realistic latency numbers
- Measurement: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, and RAM/KV hit rate

Execution notes: run each profile for 10 minutes, collect traces, and send logs back to us for validation. We can run a parallel internal run against an identical model variant to ensure apples-to-apples.

[Attachment: benchmark_script.sh (bash, 8KB)]

On Sun, Feb 4, 2028 at 11:00 AM Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — this aligns with what Accelerator asked for.
>
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@acceleratorai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Shaw <tim.shaw@ecoserve.io>, procurement@acceleratorai.com
Date: Mon, 06 Feb 2028 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity upgrade & procurement timeline

Diego / Team —

Quick update from our side: competitor X has proposed an in-region trial starting 2/8 with a follow-on 6-month discounted reserved option. Procurement is asking for a firm Redwood committed price and the ability to include a tech and ops review in our RFP.

Can Redwood provide a firm 12-month uplift price by EOD 2/6 so we can get it into the procurement packet? Also confirm whether Redwood can support a 2-week ramp/canary and a 24/7 incident hotline during the first 30 days post-cutover.

Appreciate the speed — we’ll run the bench tomorrow and will share preliminary logs.

Elena
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acceleratorai.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Feb 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity upgrade & procurement timeline

Elena —

Thank you for the update and for running the bench. Based on the results you shared, Redwood is prepared to provide the following intervention offer to de-risk migration and neutralize the competitive swap: 

Commercial & Capacity: 
- Committed 12-month uplift for 2x peak capacity at list price less 20% (final numbers to be adjusted after we receive peak token/day).
- One-time onboarding credit: equivalent to 5% of the first-year committed spend (applied as invoice credit).

Operational guarantees: 
- 2-week ramp/canary plan with a guaranteed pre-warm for top 10% requests
- 24/7 on-call support for the first 30 days + weekly post-mortem syncs during ramp
- Dedicated success manager and priority bug triage (escalation path documented)

Next steps: 
1) Please review the attached draft SOW and sign to accept the uplift terms.
2) We’ll schedule a technical kickoff within 48 hours of signature.

[Attachment: SOW_Accelerator_Uplift_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 46KB)]

If it helps procurement, we can also provide a short on-prem compliance addendum. Happy to hop on a call to walk through the SOW.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
